headline: SEBI penalises Praveg Ltd ₹2 lakh for merger disclosure lapses
hook: Small compliance penalty for a listed firm
summary: Markets regulator SEBI has levied a penalty of ₹2 lakh on Praveg Ltd for failing to make proper disclosures regarding a merger scheme. The enforcement action highlights regulatory scrutiny over corporate disclosure norms during structural reorganizations. For Indian retail investors, the penalty is financially negligible but signals strict regulatory watch on procedural compliance by listed entities.
why_it_matters: Minor regulatory penalty with negligible financial impact on investors.

headline: SEBI passes adjudication order regarding Praveg Limited
hook: Routine regulatory review at Praveg Limited
summary: SEBI has issued an adjudication order concerning Praveg Limited, formerly known as Praveg Communications India Limited. The regulatory filing details findings from an inquiry into the company. Such orders form part of standard market surveillance and enforcement procedures by the regulator. Retail investors should review the specific findings of the order to assess any potential compliance or governance implications for the company.
why_it_matters: Regulatory order details compliance findings for Praveg Limited
